rules.escalation: Clarify unresolved authority or domain decisions before execution; after a focused Sol High run fails a named check, use the bounded Astra escalation chain.
Stop on unresolved high-impact assumptions; do not substitute more effort for missing authority or evidence.
After a named validator failure, move to Sol Medium; use Sol High only after a verified Sol Medium failure.
Raise effort one step only after a named deterministic check fails.
After a named Sol High failure, use the bounded Astra escalation chain.
After a named Sol High failure, use the bounded Astra escalation chain.

fallback.escalation: Name the failed check, then raise effort or tier one step according to the failure type.

ultra.note: Ultra is eligible only for explicit parallel decomposition; it is never selected automatically.
